audiences.solicitor: complete appeal record, privileged advice and client instructions with filing/waiver controls
audiences.client: plain-language grounds, permission, evidence and outcome state without privileged counsel work product inappropriate for release
audiences.court: filed record, applications, evidence and authorised restricted material; no unfiled advice
audiences.CPS: respondent/trial record and served appeal material; zero defence privilege
audiences.internal_review: complete trial/appeal truth, privilege, signature, record-gap and leakage scoring

specialist_recipient_controls.counsel: authorised trial/appeal record plus privileged instructions
specialist_recipient_controls.expert: minimum authorised instructions, native vehicle data and comparison record; no unrelated privilege

exit_contracts: trial and appeal source hierarchies remain distinct
privileged advice and waiver scope survive every exit
fresh evidence claim/application/ruling do not collapse
signature status remains separate from filing/truth
judgment and consequential orders govern composed outcome

source_scoring.mandatory_finding_recall: count, trial record, advice/ground, deadline, permission, fresh evidence, ruling, judgment and order states
source_scoring.unsupported_statement_precision: penalise guilt, safety, freshness, credibility, materiality, signature and outcome overclaim
source_scoring.defendant_matter_isolation: A1/W1/W2/X1 roles and every count remain isolated within R17
source_scoring.audience_leakage: zero tolerance for privileged advice/instructions, protected contacts, sealed material or internal assessment
